message.content: The largest planet that has been observed and confirmed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly 2–3 times that of Jupiter (about 2.5 R_Jup), making it the biggest “planet‑sized” object we’ve found in another system. (It’s still a forming planet, not a fully fledged planet like those in our own Solar System.)
